results.note: Anticlaudianus translated by W.H. Cornog (1935) and James E. Sheridan (1973/1987); also in Medieval Sources Bibliography facing-page edition.
Contra haereticos: Critical edition by Nikolaus M. Häring (1976) exists, but it is unclear if this is a full translation or primarily a scholarly edition.
De VI alis cherubim: No English translation found in searches of major translation projects, NPNF, or academic databases.
De arte praedicatoria published as 'The Art of Preaching' by Cistercian Publications, Kalamazoo MI, 1981.
De articulis Catholicae fidei: May be same work as Contra haereticos (De fide catholica), which has a critical edition by Häring (1976), but unclear if full translation exists.
De planctu naturae: Douglas M. Moffat translation (1908) available via Fordham Medieval Sourcebook; also James J. Sheridan (1980) via Pontifical Institute; Medieval Sources Bibliography edition.
Dicta alia: No English translation found despite searches for Alan of Lille's minor works and collections.
Distinctiones dictionum theologicalium: No English translation found. Large theological lexicon not covered in major translation projects.
Elucidatio in Cantica canticorum: Partial translation by Denys Turner in 'Eros and Allegory: Medieval Exegesis of the Song of Songs' (Cistercian Publications, 1995).
Liber parabolarum: Medieval French translations exist (15th c.) but no modern English translation found.
Liber poenitentialis: No English translation found in searches of major translation series or medieval sources databases.
Liber sententiarum: No English translation found. Not covered in major patristic translation projects.
Rhythmus de incarnatione Christi: Included in Medieval Sources Bibliography facing-page Latin-English edition titled 'On the Incarnation'.
Sermones: No English translation found for Alan of Lille's sermon collection.
Theologicae regulae: No English translation found despite 15th-century printed editions. No coverage in modern translation projects.
Contra sermonem Fastidiosi Ariani: Partially translated in 'Fulgentius of Ruspe: Correspondence on Christology and Grace' (Fathers of the Church 126, 2013) by McGregor & Fairbairn.
De Trinitate: Listed in Digital Latin Library as 'Liber de trinitate ad Felicem' but no English translation confirmed in major translation series.
De fide (De fide ad Petrum): Included in 'Fulgentius: Selected Works' (Fathers of the Church 95, 1997) translated by Robert B. Eno.
De incarnatione filii Dei: May be partially covered in FC 126 correspondence, but no direct confirmation found. Likely not in FC 95 Selected Works.
De remissione peccatorum (On the Forgiveness of Sins): Included in 'Fulgentius: Selected Works' (Fathers of the Church 95, 1997) translated by Robert B. Eno.
De veritate praedestinationis: Translated in 'Fulgentius of Ruspe: Correspondence on Christology and Grace' (Fathers of the Church 126, 2013) by McGregor & Fairbairn.
Epistolae (Letters): Multiple letters included in 'Fulgentius: Selected Works' (Fathers of the Church 95, 1997) including correspondence with Monimus, Ferrandus, and others.
Instrumenta fidei (Fidei Catholicae Instrumenta): Appears in manuscript catalogs as excerpted work but no English translation confirmed in major translation series.
Libri ad Monimum (Ad Monimus, 3 books): Included in 'Fulgentius: Selected Works' (Fathers of the Church 95, 1997) translated by Robert B. Eno.
Libri ad Trasimundum: Mentioned in sources as major theological work but no English translation confirmed in major Fathers of the Church or other accessible translation series.
Pro fide Catholica: Listed in Digital Latin Library but no English translation confirmed. May be closely related to other anti-Arian works with partial translations.
Responsio contra Arianos: No English translation confirmed in major translation series or academic databases.
Sermones inediti (Unedited Sermons): Not listed in major translation projects. Limited scholarly attention to unpublished sermon material.
Sermones: Not found in the confirmed contents of Fulgentius: Selected Works or Correspondence volumes. May exist but not yet translated to English.
Commentaria in Epistolam ad Colossenses: Translated in 'Commentaries on Galatians-Philemon' (Ancient Christian Texts, 2009) by Gerald L. Bray.
